name: Purple Agrotech Industries Limited
about: Purple Agrotech Industries Limited provides entertainment, media, and short film production solutions. It is involved in short film making, shooting ad film making, advertising management, live shows, and entertainment solutions. The company also provides portfolio and modelling photography; live concerts; corporate seminars; product launching promotion; and organizing of award shows. In addition, it offers marriage functions, general company meetings, get to gather on occasions, birthday parties, etc. The company was formerly known as Purple Entertainment Limited and changed its name to Purple Agrotech Industries Limited in November 2025. Purple Agrotech Industries Limited was incorporated in 1974 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
